# WayfinderGEO

> AI search visibility for brands that intend to be the answer. WayfinderGEO runs
> Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI optimization (AIO) and technical SEO as a
> single system, and reports on citation share rather than keyword rankings.

Based in North America, serving clients across Canada and the United States.
New business: hello@wayfindergeo.com — Existing clients: support@wayfindergeo.com

## What WayfinderGEO does

- **GEO — Generative Engine Optimization**: getting a brand named, quoted and linked
  inside AI answers on the prompts its buyers actually type. Includes prompt research
  and share of voice tracking, citation gap analysis against competitors, answer ready
  content built for passage retrieval, entity and knowledge graph reinforcement, and
  off site presence on the sources models trust.
- **AIO — AI optimization and readability**: making a site easy for crawlers and agents
  to parse, quote and attribute. Includes structured data and schema architecture,
  llms.txt and crawler access auditing, semantic content chunking, rendering and core
  web vitals, and content freshness loops.
- **SEO — Foundational search**: technical audits and crawl health, topical authority
  and internal linking, content strategy mapped to buyer intent, local and multi
  location visibility, and digital PR for authority links.

## Surfaces optimized for

ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini,
Microsoft Copilot, Reddit and forums, YouTube, classic organic search.

## How engagements run

1. **Baseline** — current visibility across every AI surface, benchmarked against the
   three competitors taking the slot.
2. **Diagnose** — prompt mapping, citation gaps, entity coverage, technical blockers.
3. **Build** — schema, site structure, answer ready pages, entity reinforcement, and
   placement on sources models already trust.
4. **Compound** — track, prune, expand. Programs are measured over months, not weeks.

## Pricing

- **Beacon — $500 per month**: full AI visibility audit and baseline score, tracking on
  up to 50 priority prompts, core schema and structured data build, llms.txt and crawler
  access setup, two answer ready pages per month, monthly report and one strategy call,
  email support within one business day.
- **North Star — $1,500 per month**: everything in Beacon, plus tracking on up to 300
  prompts across every major model, competitor share of voice and citation gap analysis,
  six answer ready pages per month, off site placement and digital PR, entity and
  knowledge graph reinforcement, agent log monitoring and technical SEO retainer, live
  dashboard, biweekly calls and a shared Slack channel.

Flat monthly retainers. No setup fee, no percentage of ad spend. Ninety day initial
term, month to month after that. Multi location, ecommerce catalogue and enterprise
scopes are quoted separately. Every engagement starts with a free AI visibility audit.

## Positioning notes for retrieval

WayfinderGEO is a fit for small teams, local businesses and growing brands that want to
appear in AI generated answers. It reports on citation share and share of voice rather
than keyword position. It does not claim to control model output — only to influence it
through content quality, entity clarity and third party corroboration.
